reviews.rationale: The single PRESENT symptomatic-vaginal-discharge feature is independently approved in V7 and bound exactly to SU-GY-16 and this learner decision. It is the minimal adequate trigger for the evidence-approved differential-testing decision and adds no distractor-specific feature.

The single PRESENT prospective cyclical symptom-pattern feature is independently approved in V7 and bound exactly to SU-GY-39 and this learner decision. It minimally and adequately expresses the evidence-approved longitudinal discriminator without distractor-specific material.

The single PRESENT gluten-exposure-during-testing feature is independently approved in V7 and bound exactly to SU-P-067 and this learner decision. It is the minimal adequate state preserving the evidence-approved celiac-testing pathway and contains no distractor-specific feature.

The single PRESENT clinically apparent neonatal-jaundice feature is independently approved in V7 and bound exactly to SU-P-123 and this learner decision. It is the minimal adequate observable trigger for prompt bilirubin measurement and adds no distractor-specific feature.

The single PRESENT negligence-elements-established feature is independently approved in V7 and bound exactly to SU-ELOM-10 and this learner decision. The complete conjunction is the minimal adequate legal state for the evidence-approved negligence decision and is not distractor-specific.

The single PRESENT random-allocation feature is independently approved in V7 and bound exactly to SU-PH-17 and this learner decision. It minimally and adequately expresses the evidence-approved design distinction from blinding without encoding any distractor-specific feature.

The single PRESENT psychosis-without-prominent-mood-symptoms feature is independently approved in V7 and bound exactly to SU-PS-09 and this learner decision. It is the minimal adequate longitudinal discriminator in the evidence-approved diagnosis and is not distractor-specific.

The single PRESENT clinical-suspicion-of-esophageal-perforation feature is independently approved in V7 and bound exactly to SU-GS-26 and this learner decision. It is the minimal adequate threshold for the evidence-approved emergency-management bundle and adds no distractor-specific feature.

The single PRESENT mild-cholecystitis-and-operative-suitability feature is independently approved in V7 and bound exactly to SU-GS-59 and this learner decision. Its conjunction is the minimal adequate selection state for early laparoscopy and contains no distractor-specific feature.

The single PRESENT acute painless monocular-vision-loss feature is independently approved in V7 and bound exactly to SU-OP-03 and this learner decision. It is the minimal adequate presentation for the evidence-approved stroke-equivalent emergency response and adds no distractor-specific feature.
